author: Kate King (@katekingauthor)
title: Looking for artist for two character art pieces
content: I am looking for an artist who has avalibilty right now to draw two pieces of character art. Anyone have an opening? Recs from authors are very welcome. Human artists only, absolutely no AI. Bots and clearly AI content will be blocked. Please only comment below do not DM me. Update: One piece is 2 characters, the other is 3. Will share more info on that privately later as this art is for my new book which is unannounced and I dont want to post too many details publicly. I have no specific style in mind, but would appreciate if you posted an example of your work in the replies. Thank you!! My PA will be checking through these later today, and I’ll reach out directly to anyone I would like to move forward with.

author: Veli Raiya (@veliraiyawrites)
title: Looking for fantasy book map designer + character illustrator
content: Looking for a fantasy book map designer + character illustrator! Definitely doesn’t have to be the same artist for both. Bonus points if you’re a fantasy author recommending someone you’ve personally worked with because I know the bots are about to find me. See the next posts for more details on what I’m looking for with each! For character art, I tend to gravitate toward more realistic, epic fantasy concept art, as opposed to a cartoon illustration. My book is on the lighter side of fantasy, but I love art that still feels grounded and lifelike. I’m definitely open to seeing different styles though, so please share your work/recs! Bonus points if you can do POC and a wide variety of ethnicities! For the map, I’d love something detailed and immersive with that classic fantasy-map feel, but I’m pretty open stylistically! It’s a very visual world, I’m so excited to describe it to someone.

author: La Biblioteca Dracónica (@maitespena)
title: Seeking illustrators for book character series (social media)
content: Se buscan ilustradores. Busco quien nos ilustre una serie de personajes, teniendo en cuenta que no todos serán humanos. Son imágenes para redes sociales, para promocionar nuestro libro. No para venderlas ni para ilustrar páginas. Sencillas, de personajes a solas o en grupo (se pedirán varias). Por favor, agradecería que añadierais vuestro portfolio y una lista de precios. También podéis escribirme en privado si lo preferís. Gracias. Update: Todos los personajes que se van a dibujar son adultos, pero algunos no son humanos (hay algunos tipos de demonios y seres mágicos entre ellos). Es una novela adulta. Buscamos algo que tenga un toque más bien sencillo porque el libro tiene mucho humor. We will review all profiles and contact those that interest us.

author: @nrfrh_azn
title: Calling all fantasy illustrators for YA novel covers
content: Calling all fantasy illustrators! I’m looking for an illustrator for my upcoming YA fantasy novel. Think dark academia, ancient magic, mysterious towers and an elegant, atmospheric fantasy aesthetic. If you create fantasy book covers, I’d love to see your portfolio! Please DM me your artwork, rates and estimated turnaround time. Recommendations are welcome too!
